evidence_reasoning: This is a report of computational errors encountered in the study.

claim: The errors in the calculation correspond to 0.006% of the total calculation results.
source_text: We performed the calculations on a total of 109,746 cell-pairs for a total of 801 E values, so these errors correspond to 0.006% of the total calculation results.
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantification of the error rate in the computational analysis.

claim: To eliminate the effect of errors, the two coefficients of the 5213 cell-pairs in the three specific E values were post-corrected to Tij(E)=0,Rij(E)=1.
source_text: To eliminate the effect of these errors in this study, we post-corrected the two coefficients of the 5213 cell-pairs in the three specific E values in which the error occurred to Tij(E)=0,Rij(E)=1.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the error correction procedure applied in the study.
